1.title: For Once, a New York Jet Is Destined to Win Something
1.summary: A House race in Arizona pits Jay Feely, a former Jets kicker, against Amish Shah, a former sideline doctor for the team. Jets fans in the district say it’s a welcome distraction from all the losing.

2.title: With Term Winding Down, Pelosi Tries to Anoint a Successor
2.summary: Representative Nancy Pelosi, the former House speaker, has been working hard on behalf of Connie Chan, a San Francisco supervisor with a relatively low profile in California.

3.title: How Key Oil Stockpiles Dwindled During the War in Iran
3.summary: Our energy reporter Rebecca F. Elliott explains how oil reserves helped prevent an oil shock caused by the war in Iran from getting even worse — and how low those reserves are now.

4.title: Live Updates: Nepal Nearly Doubles Number of Missing to 1,900 Amid Desperate Search for Survivors
4.summary: A spokeswoman for the disaster relief agency said the tally grew after some 900 people were reported missing from hydropower projects. Rescue efforts were complicated by fears of new possible flooding.

5.title: Inside Afghanistan’s Secret Schools for Girls
5.summary: The Taliban have banned education for millions of Afghan girls. Times journalists examined classrooms where students, teachers and parents continue to resist by defying the rules.

6.title: ‘The Sauna Is Hot and Uncomfortable’: Vote on E.U. Talks Makes Iceland Sweat
6.summary: The usually genial country is been bitterly divided over a vote this weekend on whether to enter membership talks with the European Union.
